featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The Apollo VX20 is part of the family of Unified Communication Apollo solutions. The VX20 is a premium conference video bar that integrates a video switcher, speakerphone, and camera into one device. Ready for today’s demanding and versatile meeting spaces, the VX20 comes feature packed with HDMI & USB-C local inputs along with the ability to wireless casting from Airplay and Miracast capable devices. The 4K camera provides enhanced features including presenter tracking and AI assisted lighting. The powerful stereo speakers provide room-filling sound with exceptional bass response for a clear and accurate audio experience.

Features 4 x MEMS microphones in a Beamforming array with Acoustic Echo Cancellation, Automatic Gain Control and Automatic Noise Suppression, ensuring you can be heard loud and clear in every meeting up to 8 meters away. The stereo speakers with bass enhancement provide crisp audio delivery, even in the largest rooms.

The integrated 4K camera not only provides a crystal-clear video conference experience but delivers smart AI enhanced functionality including intelligent backlighting, auto-framing, presenter tracking and speaker tracking.

Compatible with all major meeting software including Microsoft Teams, Zoom, WebEx, BlueJeans and many more. No matter what you or your company use to collaborate, the VX20 provides the fundamental connectivity to have a successful meeting.

Add on the APO-COM-MIC USB microphone for expanded pickup range in your meeting space. This microphone features a 360 degree pick-up angle at a distance up to 5m (16ft). Cascade up to 5 mics and ensure even the largest rooms are fully covered.

The APO-DG1 features an incredibly easy to use experience. Compatible with any USB-C laptop, simply connect the dongle to an available USB-C port and then tap the button to begin sharing your desktop. No more confusing or complicated connections required.
Native USB-C connection provides up to 60w device charging for laptops or tablets
